content: Knowledge is the supreme wealth: thieves cannot steal it, kings cannot confiscate it, and sharing it only causes it to multiply.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Na choraharyam na cha rajaharyam (न चोरहार्यं न च राजहार्यम्) — Bhartrihari's Niti Shataka
explanation: Material gold must be guarded behind iron vaults, and when given away, your personal supply diminishes. But sacred knowledge (Vidya) is weightless to carry, immune to theft or taxation, and every time you pour it into another human soul, your own illumination expands.
practicalInsight: Freely teach a skill, share an insight, or explain a concept to someone today. Experience the joy of knowledge expanding.
reflectionPrompt: Are you hoarding what you know out of professional insecurity, or are you lighting other candles with your flame?
